description: Single source of truth for CardioVanta's production clinical input schema and outcome semantics. Generated code: backend/app/schemas/generated_features.py and src/types/generated-features.ts (python contracts/codegen/generate.py). Do not hand-edit generated files.

compatible_model_input_schema.note: The frozen production model's input schema. This contract must stay consistent with it (same 13 features, order, types, accepted codes and development ranges).

verification_levels.verified_patient_matched: Code meaning established by 1-to-1 patient matching between the training encoding and the canonical UCI records.
verification_levels.codebook_and_project_contract: Code meaning stated by the UCI codebook using the same code values, and adopted by the project domain contract. Not independently patient-matched.
verification_levels.unverified: Code is an accepted model input, but its correspondence to a canonical clinical category has not been established. The display label is a legacy UI label and must not be presented as verified.
verification_levels.undefined_in_codebook: Code is an accepted model input, but the UCI codebook does not define it. No clinical meaning is asserted (not assumed to mean 'missing').

outcome.label: Significant obstructive coronary artery disease
outcome.clinical_definition: Angiographic coronary artery disease: greater than 50% diameter stenosis in at least one major coronary vessel (UCI 'num' > 0).
outcome.probability_definition: Calibrated model-estimated probability that significant obstructive coronary artery disease is present (angiographic >50% diameter narrowing; UCI 'num' > 0). Research estimate only; not a diagnosis and not clinically validated.
evidence: uci_codebook: attribute 58 'num' (diagnosis of heart disease, angiographic disease status): value 0 = < 50% diameter narrowing; value 1 = > 50% diameter narrowing in any major vessel

model_label_mappings.description: Artifact-specific mapping from a trained model's class labels to the clinical outcome above. This is model metadata, NOT the definition of the clinical outcome. Future packages must declare outcome_semantics.disease_present_label in their own metadata.

packages.reason: Trained by src/experiment/phase5.py on the raw target column of data/raw/heart.csv, whose encoding is inverted relative to UCI num (target 1 = num == 0, healthy; target 0 = num > 0, disease).

development_range.behaviour: values outside are accepted and flagged with a development-range warning

features.label: Chest Pain Type
features.description: Chest pain type, in the training data's (Kaggle) encoding. Canonical UCI codes differ: 1 typical, 2 atypical, 3 non-anginal, 4 asymptomatic.

features.label: Resting Blood Pressure
features.description: Resting blood pressure on admission to the hospital.
features.unit_evidence: uci_codebook: 'trestbps: resting blood pressure (in mm Hg on admission to the hospital)'

development_range.behaviour: values outside are accepted and flagged with a development-range warning
values outside are accepted and flagged with a development-range warning

features.label: Fasting Blood Sugar > 120 mg/dl
features.description: Whether fasting blood sugar exceeds 120 mg/dl.
evidence: uci_codebook: 'fbs: (fasting blood sugar > 120 mg/dl) (1 = true; 0 = false)'

features.label: Resting ECG Results

options.clinical_meaning: probable or definite left ventricular hypertrophy (Estes' criteria)

evidence: uci_codebook: attribute 19 'restecg' (0 normal, 1 ST-T wave abnormality, 2 LVH)
project_domain_contract: 'Resting ECG: 0 = normal, 1 = ST-T wave abnormality, 2 = LVH'

features.label: Maximum Heart Rate Achieved
features.description: Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise testing.
features.unit_evidence: uci_codebook: 'thalach: maximum heart rate achieved' (unit not stated; heart rate is conventionally beats per minute)

development_range.behaviour: values outside are accepted and flagged with a development-range warning

features.label: Exercise Induced Angina
evidence: uci_codebook: 'exang: exercise induced angina (1 = yes; 0 = no)'

features.label: ST Depression Induced by Exercise
features.description: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest.
features.unit_evidence: uci_codebook does not state a unit; 'mm' is the pre-R1 UI display convention (unverified)

development_range.behaviour: values outside are accepted and flagged with a development-range warning

evidence: uci_codebook: 'oldpeak = ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest'

features.label: Slope of Peak Exercise ST Segment
features.description: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment, in the training data's encoding (0-2). The UCI codebook uses 1 upsloping, 2 flat, 3 downsloping; no project mapping between the two encodings has been established.

features.label: Number of Major Vessels
features.description: Number of major vessels (0-3) colored by fluoroscopy. The training encoding additionally contains code 4, which the UCI codebook does not define.
evidence: uci_codebook: attribute 44 'ca: number of major vessels (0-3) colored by flourosopy'

features.label: Thallium Stress Test
features.description: Thallium scintigraphy result, in the training data's encoding (0-3). The UCI codebook uses 3 normal, 6 fixed defect, 7 reversable defect; no project mapping between the two encodings has been established.
evidence: uci_codebook: attribute 51 'thal: 3 = normal; 6 = fixed defect; 7 = reversable defect'
